AGRICULTURE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning the Kitchen? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning the Kitchen.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning the Kitchen.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning the Kitchen.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning the Kitchen.

2. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

3. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Harvesting and Storage? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Harvesting and Storage.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Harvesting and Storage.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Kitchen and Backyard Gardening? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.

7. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving animal products? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving animal products.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving animal products.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving animal products.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving animal products.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preparation of Animal Products? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preparation of Animal Products.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing.

12. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil Conservation Measures? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil Conservation Measures.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Soil Conservation Measures.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil Conservation Measures.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil Conservation Measures.

14. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Pest and Disease Control? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Pest and Disease Control.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Pest and Disease Control.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Pest and Disease Control.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Pest and Disease Control.

16. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Producers

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Poultry Rearing in a Fold? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Poultry Rearing in a Fold.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Poultry Rearing in a Fold.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Poultry Rearing in a Fold.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Poultry Rearing in a Fold.

18. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only water vapour

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal.

20. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Milk souring

21. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

22. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. watt (W)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)
